# Wrenfield & Cole - Ashwell despatch

One row per load, written by the loading bay. A load is recorded both ways: the
number of cases that went on the pallet and the bottle count of the same
consignment, twelve bottles to a case.

turns.prompt: Wrenfield & Cole is closing the September summary for the Ashwell account. How much cider did Ashwell take in September?
